description: Targeted ungapped search for the most-conserved ODA16-region motif (CrIFT46 119-133) across orthologs, with a shuffled-sequence null for DYF-6

import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62_txt="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
Lx=B62_txt.strip().split('\n'); hdr=Lx[0].split(); B62={}
for l in Lx[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(hdr,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def ungapped_best(s,motif):
    """best ungapped 15-mer window in s against motif: returns (score, start1, window, nid)"""
    L=len(motif); best=(-999,0,'',0)
    for i in range(len(s)-L+1):
        w=s[i:i+L]; sco=sum(sc(a,b) for a,b in zip(w,motif)); nid=sum(a==b for a,b in zip(w,motif))
        if sco>best[0]: best=(sco,i+1,w,nid)
    return best
def uget(a): return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90).json()['sequence']['value']

MOTIF="LFSYIGRYKPQTVEL"   # CrIFT46 119-133, best-conserved window of the ODA16-binding region
panel=[('Chlamydomonas reinhardtii','A2T2X4','motile'),('Homo sapiens','Q9NQC8','motile'),
       ('Mus musculus','Q9DB07','motile'),('Danio rerio','Q6DRN0','motile'),
       ('Xenopus tropicalis','Q28H29','motile'),('Trypanosoma brucei','Q57UX3','motile'),
       ('Schistosoma mansoni','A0A3Q0KNK3','motile'),('Tetrahymena thermophila',None,'motile'),
       ('Caenorhabditis elegans','Q0G838','nematode'),('Brugia malayi','A8PYM6','nematode'),
       ('Strongyloides ratti','A0A090LGF7','nematode'),('Caenorhabditis briggsae','A8XQI8','nematode')]
rows=[]
for name,acc,g in panel:
    if acc is None: continue
    try: s=uget(acc)
    except Exception: print("skip",name,acc); continue
    half=s[:int(len(s)*0.60)]           # search the N-terminal 60% only
    sco,st,win,nid=ungapped_best(half,MOTIF)
    rows.append(dict(species=name,group=g,acc=acc,length=len(s),start=st,window=win,score=sco,n_identical=nid,pct_id=100*nid/15))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(['group','score'],ascending=[True,False])
print("Targeted ungapped search for the CrIFT46 119-133 motif (%s) in the N-terminal 60%% of each ortholog\n"%MOTIF)
print(df[['species','group','acc','start','window','score','n_identical','pct_id']].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:'%.1f'%x))
from scipy import stats
m=df[df.group=='motile'].score.values; n=df[df.group=='nematode'].score.values
U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(m,n,alternative='greater')
print("\nMotile scores %s (median %.0f) vs nematode %s (median %.0f); Mann-Whitney one-sided p=%.3f"%(
    sorted(m,reverse=True),np.median(m),sorted(n,reverse=True),np.median(n),p))
ce=df[df.species=='Caenorhabditis elegans'].iloc[0]
print("\nC. elegans DYF-6 hit: residues %d-%d  %s  score %d, %d/15 identical (%.0f%%)"%(
    ce.start,ce.start+14,ce.window,ce.score,ce.n_identical,ce.pct_id))
print("Motile median score %.0f; DYF-6 score %d is at percentile %.0f of the motile set."%(
    np.median(m),ce.score,100*np.mean(m<=ce.score)))
# null: what score would a random 15-mer give? shuffle DYF-6 and re-search 2000x
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); s=uget('Q0G838'); half=list(s[:int(len(s)*0.60)]); null=[]
for _ in range(2000):
    rng.shuffle(half); null.append(ungapped_best(''.join(half),MOTIF)[0])
null=np.array(null)
print("Shuffled-sequence null for DYF-6: mean best score %.1f (sd %.1f); observed %d, empirical p=%.4f"%(
    null.mean(),null.std(),ce.score,(null>=ce.score).mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.3,1]})
cols={'motile':'#1f77b4','nematode':'#d62728'}
d2=df.sort_values('score')
ax[0].barh(range(len(d2)),d2.score,color=[cols[g] for g in d2.group])
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(d2))); ax[0].set_yticklabels([f"{r.species}\n{r.window}" for r in d2.itertuples()],fontsize=7)
ax[0].axvline(null.mean(),color='k',ls=':',lw=1.4)
ax[0].text(null.mean(),len(d2)-0.6,' shuffled-sequence null',fontsize=7,va='top')
ax[0].set_xlabel('BLOSUM62 score of best ungapped match to CrIFT46 119-133')
ax[0].set_title('The ODA16-binding motif block is retained in DYF-6',fontsize=10)
ax[1].hist(null,bins=25,color='#999999',edgecolor='w')
ax[1].axvline(ce.score,color='#d62728',lw=2.2)
ax[1].text(ce.score,ax[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.9,' DYF-6 observed\n score %d, p=%.3f'%(ce.score,(null>=ce.score).mean()),fontsize=8,color='#d62728')
ax[1].set_xlabel('best motif score in shuffled DYF-6 N-terminal region'); ax[1].set_ylabel('count')
ax[1].set_title('2000 shuffles',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
